pulse.source: DTRH CPI with EIA Table 8.4 electricity price

caveats.detail: Island retail restarts on a new sheet (VENTAS AL DETAL) at 2025-07, structurally ~higher than the old VENTAS sheet. Retail YoY is suppressed until 12 new-vintage months exist (2026-07); only level and within-vintage MoM are shown across the seam.

Real (CPI-deflated) series can lag nominal by 1-2 months because PR All-Items CPI publishes later. CPI is forward-filled up to 2 months so rolling/TTM windows don't punch holes; the deflator base is the latest available CPI month.
The near-zero auto-sales point in Apr 2020 (287 units) is REAL — the island-wide COVID lockdown, not a data error. It is annotated, not filtered, and it widens any window that includes it.
